title: Faster dashboard
items: Signed-in pages and API calls no longer wait about 400 ms for a session check that went out to the internet and back: the server checks the session over the private network, and only when a page loads
Switching endpoints shows the new endpoint at once instead of after a round trip to the server
The dashboard asks for the endpoint list once instead of twice, and the header keeps the switcher's place while it loads, so the page no longer jumps on phones
When the endpoint list cannot be loaded, the dashboard says so and offers to try again, instead of creating a first endpoint
